title.narrative: First emergency initiative in response to the earthquake in Venezuela
Iniziativa di primissima emergenza in risposta al terremoto in Venezuela

description.narrative: L'iniziativa mira a contribuire a salvare vite umane e a ridurre la sofferenza delle popolazioni in condizione di vulnerabilità del Venezuela, colpite da una crisi umanitaria complessa e strutturale, aggravata dal terremoto del 24 giugno 2026.L'intervento fornisce una risposta rapida e multisettoriale ai bisogni immediati generati dal sisma, tra cui shelter, sicurezza alimentare e nutrizionale, WASH e supporto psicosociale, e rafforza al contempo l'accesso ai servizi essenziali, la salute comunitaria con particolare attenzione alla salute sessuale e riproduttiva e alla violenza basata sul genere, e l'integrazione socioeconomica delle persone rientrate dopo esperienze migratorie. I beneficiari sono le popolazioni colpite dal sisma e le persone in condizione di vulnerabilità socioeconomica e protezionale, con priorità a donne, minori, persone con disabilità e migranti di ritorno.

The initiative aims to help saving lives and reducing the suffering of Venezuela's populations in vulnerable conditions, affected by a complex and structural humanitarian crisis further aggravated by the earthquake of 24 June 2026. The intervention provides a rapid, multisectoral response to the immediate needs generated by the earthquake, including shelter, food security and nutrition, WASH and psychosocial support, while also strengthening access to essential services, community health with particular attention to sexual and reproductive health and gender-based violence, and the socioeconomic integration of returnees. Beneficiaries are populations affected by the earthquake and people facing socioeconomic and protection-related vulnerability, with priority given to women, children, persons with disabilities and Returnees.

tag.narrative: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls

By 2030, achieve universal and equitable access to safe and affordable drinking water for all

By 2030, build the resilience of the poor and those in vulnerable situations and reduce their exposure and vulnerability to climate-related extreme events and other economic, social and environmental shocks and disasters

End hunger, achieve food security and improved nutrition and promote sustainable agriculture
End poverty in all its forms everywhere
Ensure availability and sustainable management of water and sanitation for all
Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages
Facilitate orderly, safe, regular and responsible migration and mobility of people, including through the implementation of planned and well-managed migration policies
Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable
Promote sustained, inclusive and sustainable economic growth, full and productive employment and decent work for all
Reduce inequality within and among countries
